description: Source code for the 'send-pack' functionality in Git, handling pack creation, object transmission, and remote status processing.

methods.name: option_parse_push_signed
methods.description: Parses and sets the push signing option based on user input.

methods.name: feed_object
methods.description: Feeds a specific object ID into the pack stream, optionally negative.

methods.name: pack_objects
methods.description: Creates a pack stream and writes objects into the provided file descriptor.

methods.name: receive_unpack_status
methods.description: Reads and interprets the remote unpack status from a packet reader.

methods.name: receive_status
methods.description: Processes status messages from the remote after push.

methods.name: sideband_demux
methods.description: Demultiplexes sideband data from the remote.

methods.name: check_to_send_update
methods.description: Determines if a ref should be sent based on its status and args.

methods.name: next_line
methods.description: Returns the start of the next line in a buffer.

methods.name: generate_push_cert
methods.description: Generates a push certificate for refs to be pushed.

methods.name: reject_invalid_nonce
methods.description: Validates the nonce string for push certificates.

methods.name: get_commons_through_negotiation
methods.description: Negotiates common objects with the remote to optimize push.

methods.name: send_pack
methods.description: Main function to send pack data and refs to remote, handling negotiation, object transfer, and status reporting.
